name: Aiven Free PostgreSQL
free_limit: One ongoing Free Aiven PostgreSQL service per organization: single node, 1 CPU, 1 GB RAM and 1 GB disk; no credit card required
watch_out: No VPC, static IP, service integrations, connection pooling, SLA or Aiven support; maximum 20 concurrent database connections. Free services have no fixed expiry but may be powered off after sustained inactivity and can be restarted; upgrading to paid requires a payment method. Aiven for MySQL Free is a separate, discontinued offer: new free MySQL service creation ended 6 November 2026; remaining MySQL Free services and their backups are scheduled for deletion 21 December 2026. This does not affect PostgreSQL Free.
